`Faker()` with no locale argument goes through `Faker.__init__`, which sets `locales = [DEFAULT_LOCALE]` and, because `len(locales) == 1`, creates exactly one underlying factory and stores it in `self._factories`. When `fake.first_name` is accessed, `Faker.__getattribute__` only special-cases `"seed"`; for `"first_name"` it falls back to normal attribute lookup, which misses and therefore invokes `Faker.__getattr__`. Inside `__getattr__`, the single-locale branch `if len(self._factories) == 1: return getattr(self._factories[0], attr)` is taken, so `_select_factory` is not called; that method is only reached by the final `else` branch used for multiple-locale proxying.
